caseName: Guss v. Utah Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Guss, doing business as Photo Sound Products Manufacturing Co. v. Utah Labor Relations Board
attorneys: Arthur J. Goldberg and David E. Feller for movant.

opinions.text: Appeal from the Supreme Court of Utah. (Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 817.) The motion to add the United Steelworkers of America as a party appellee is denied. The United Steelworkers of America may file a brief, amicus curiae, if it desires. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief, as amicus curiae.
